title: Game News Round-Up
summary: Daily curated games-industry news digest for 11 September 2026.

items.title: Ikea has released a **Skyrim** mod where players are accompanied by a Kallax shelving unit voiced by Matt Berry
**Project Dream**, Rare’s SNES prototype which evolved into Banjo-Kazooie, has leaked after 30+ years
bullets: The rom has been shared online as a protest against Microsoft and its treatment of Rare (and other studios) in recent years

items.title: **Switch 2** system update adds VRR support when docked, Switch 2 to Switch 2 system transfer and more
bullets: More features added include changes to game chat (including a viewable history of previous chats) alongside improvements to Virtual Game Card functionality

items.title: Hideo Kojima’s **Physint** has jumped from PlayStation to Xbox, after Kojima says Sony tried to cancel it
bullets: In a statement posted on X, Kojima said that Sony had told him it was cancelling the game three months ago, and he has since been trying to find a new partner to work with in order to keep it alive

items.title: **Ubisoft** Steam games to no longer require the Connect launcher, in "initial step toward a smoother and more streamlined launch experience"
bullets: Feature starts as a "test" with Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown. In a Steam Post, Ubisoft explained that it's a new tool called "Ubisoft Connect Services Steam Tool" that promises to keep Connect features like cross-progression, cross-play, rewards "without requiring the Ubisoft Connect PC launcher to be installed or launched"

items.title: **Wardogs** Sells a Million Copies and Blows Past 300k Concurrent Players on Launch Day
